newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures rise amid pre-EU tender buying.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures rise amid pre-EU tender buying.

text.p: LIFFE wheat firmed as shipper buying ahead of Thursday's EU tender again stressed the market's firm underlying tone.
May wheat last traded 0.55 stg higher, at 100.35 stg. May dominated trade, with 319 of a total 579 lots traded.
"It's shipper buying with a view to a healthy (EU) restitution," one trader said.
He noted that there were still signs of active farmer selling, demonstrated by country merchants' interest in the market.
Sterling softened against the mark which helped the market to some extent, although traders noted that it was still at relatively high levels, and felt that it was not the major factor in the market.
Barley was more muted than wheat with all the 18 lots which changed hands done at unchanged levels.
